correctness.rationale: The flag torus equals the quotient of the simply connected triangular tiling by the index-13 lattice a+3b=0 mod13. The exact hex-grid geodesic norm gives six minimum nonzero deck vectors; four cyclic geodesic orders at each base vertex give 13 simple essential four-cycles in each of three sign-paired directions. All zero-displacement simple four-cycles are the 39 two-triangle rhombi. The integral affine matrix follows from lifting 3 to (a,b)->(-b,a-b). A standalone exhaustive verifier independently checks the 13-vertex finite census, vectors, matrices and orbits.

value.rationale: The 13-point Paley flag torus is a canonical vertex-transitive genus-one triangulation and an exceptional early member of a natural cyclic family. Integral edge-systole length, the precise number of carriers, and their primitive H1 classes are intrinsic graph-topological invariants. Their three-direction affine-transitive shell provides a meaningful special geometric contrast with the one-direction n>=17 tail and a checkable benchmark for combinatorial systoles; neither correctness nor computability alone is offered as value.
